mechanism: Ashwagandha can raise serum T4/T3, adding to exogenous thyroid hormone.
advice: Check TSH before continuing both. Consider spacing or dose review by the prescribing physician.
reference: Case reports of thyrotoxicosis with Withania somnifera; J Ayurveda Integr Med

mechanism: Additive CNS depression with sedative-anxiolytics.
advice: Warn about daytime drowsiness; avoid driving until effect is known.

mechanism: Guggulsterones induce CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein, reducing propranolol bioavailability.
advice: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate; beta-blocker effect may be reduced.
reference: Br J Clin Pharmacol, guggulipid pharmacokinetic studies

mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces calcium-channel blocker exposure.
advice: Watch for loss of BP control.
reference: Br J Clin Pharmacol, guggulipid pharmacokinetic studies

mechanism: Momordica charantia has independent hypoglycaemic action, additive to metformin.
advice: Higher hypoglycaemia risk. Advise glucose self-monitoring and counsel on hypo symptoms.
reference: Systematic reviews of Momordica charantia in T2DM

mechanism: Fenugreek lowers postprandial glucose, additive to sulfonylurea.
advice: Significant hypoglycaemia risk, especially if meals are skipped. Physician should review dosing.

mechanism: Syzygium cumini seed powder has hypoglycaemic activity.
advice: Monitor for hypoglycaemia; insulin dose may need adjustment.

mechanism: Terminalia arjuna has inotropic activity; potential additive cardiac effect and narrow digoxin index.
advice: Do not combine without digoxin level monitoring.

mechanism: Additive diuresis with risk of hypokalaemia and volume depletion.
advice: Check electrolytes; caution in elderly patients.

mechanism: Glycyrrhizin causes sodium retention and potassium loss, opposing antihypertensive effect.
advice: Avoid prolonged high-dose liquorice in hypertensive patients; check BP and potassium.

mechanism: Compounded potassium loss leading to hypokalaemia.
advice: Check serum potassium before continuing.

mechanism: Bacopa monnieri may alter phenytoin plasma concentration.
advice: Monitor seizure control and phenytoin levels.

mechanism: Documented reduction in phenytoin plasma levels with loss of seizure control.
advice: Avoid co-administration. This is one of the best-documented Ayurveda-allopathy interactions.
reference: Classic reported interaction, Indian J Pharmacol

mechanism: Curcumin has antiplatelet activity; additive bleeding risk.
advice: Check INR. Stop turmeric supplements before any procedure.

mechanism: Allium sativum inhibits platelet aggregation; raises bleeding risk.
advice: Advise on bleeding signs and check INR.

mechanism: Additive antiplatelet effect.
advice: Counsel on bruising and gastrointestinal bleeding.

mechanism: Tinospora cordifolia is immunostimulant, opposing immunosuppression.
advice: Avoid in transplant recipients and autoimmune patients on immunosuppressants.

mechanism: Opposing immunological actions may reduce steroid efficacy.
advice: Review indication with the treating physician.

mechanism: Laxative effect can cause potassium loss, increasing digoxin toxicity risk.
advice: Avoid prolonged use; monitor potassium.

mechanism: Altered gut transit may reduce levothyroxine absorption.
advice: Separate administration by at least four hours.

mechanism: Rauwolfia serpentina lowers blood pressure; additive hypotension.
advice: High risk of symptomatic hypotension in the elderly. Physician review required.

mechanism: Reserpine depletes monoamines and may precipitate depression.
advice: Avoid in patients on antidepressants.

mechanism: Both act as bronchodilators; generally complementary.
advice: No routine action needed. Recheck if tremor or palpitation appears.

mechanism: Both are gastric irritants; additive mucosal injury.
advice: Consider gastroprotection; review need for NSAID.

mechanism: Possible additive glucose-lowering effect.
advice: Routine glucose monitoring is sufficient.

mechanism: Emblica officinalis shows antiplatelet activity.
advice: Counsel on bleeding risk before any invasive procedure.

mechanism: Diuretic action can reduce lithium clearance and raise levels.
advice: Check lithium level if used together.

mechanism: Azadirachta indica has hypoglycaemic activity, additive to sulfonylurea.
advice: Monitor glucose, especially in fasting patients.
